# Magic UI

> > Magic UI is an open-source library of 150+ animated React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS components built on shadcn/ui for creating high-converting landing pages and marketing sites.

Magic UI provides copy-paste components optimized for design engineers and frontend developers, with a Pro tier offering Next.js templates and pre-built landing page sections. The library is trusted by Y Combinator companies, Google Ventures startups, and Vercel AI Accelerator participants.

## Key Topics

- React Components
- Tailwind CSS
- TypeScript
- Next.js
- shadcn/ui
- Animated Components
- Landing Pages
- UI Component Library
- Design Engineers

- User Experience

## Getting Started

- [Magic UI](https://v3.magicui.design): Homepage: 150+ animated React/TypeScript/Tailwind components for shadcn/ui
- [Introduction](https://v3.magicui.design/docs): Magic UI intro: copy-paste React components for landing pages & marketing
- [Installation](https://v3.magicui.design/docs/installation): Installation guide: setup Next.js project with shadcn/ui-compatible CLI
- [Manual Installation](https://v3.magicui.design/docs/installation/manual): Manual setup: add Tailwind CSS, dependencies, icons & path aliases

## Products & Templates

- [Magic UI Pro](https://pro.magicui.design): Magic UI Pro: 9+ Next.js templates & 50+ landing page sections library
- [Magic UI v2](https://magicui.design): Homepage v2: Codeforge template & 150+ React/Tailwind animated components
- [Showcase](https://v3.magicui.design/showcase): Showcase: YC companies & portfolios built with Magic UI landing pages
